nodes.snippet: Haunted Thursday 🎃 Show me your Halloween. Pumpkin patches,…
nodes.text: Haunted Thursday 🎃 Show me your Halloween. Pumpkin patches, porch carvings, decorations, foggy corners, odd shadows - festive or full-on creepy, all of it counts. This big guy is on pumpkin duty all October. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Best of the week lands on Instagram on the weekend.
photos: A full-sized skeleton stands in a front yard as part of a Halloween decoration, leaning on a weed whacker. Three carved plastic pumpkins rest on the grass in front of it.

A weathered, blue and red truck bed is creatively decorated as a festive autumn and Halloween display, topped with a large, grinning metal alligator. Pumpkins, ghosts, and various whimsical decorations surround the vehicle in a welcoming seasonal setup.

A menacing, black-and-white-clad killer clown glares into the camera, brandishing a bloody knife in one hand while reaching out threateningly with the other. The dramatic, shadowy lighting and sinister makeup create the ultimate horror-movie vibe, perfect for Halloween thrills.

A black and white, low-angle, vertical photo captures a narrow, brick-walled alleyway at night. A wrought-iron fence frames the bottom, featuring vertical spikes and scrollwork designs. Beyond the fence, stone steps ascend through the tight space, illuminated by two vintage wall-mounted lamps. The primary lamp in the lower-left foreground is large and bright, while the smaller lamp is positioned further up the dark alley. The stark contrast between the bright lights and dark shadows creates a moody, gothic atmosphere.

A tall, spooky Halloween decoration featuring a grinning pumpkin head and a hunchbacked, gaunt body stands in front of a house, its tattered greenish-yellow robes draped over tree-bark-textured limbs as its long, clawed fingers reach forward.
A headless figure stands on a path covered in leaves, with a glowing jack-o'-lantern held where their head should be.

replies.text: Headless, but still carrying the pumpkin with total confidence. The leaves on the path finish the whole look.

photos: A large, plastic, human-like skeleton emerges from a patch of green grass in front of a house decorated for Halloween. The decoration consists of the skeleton's upper body and a pair of outstretched arms, with the hands resting on the grass, surrounded by fake spiderwebs and dead leaves.

replies.text: Climbing out of the lawn and already posing. The spiderwebs say he's been down there a while.

photos: A spooky Halloween display features an archway of glowing purple skulls and a skeleton playing a green guitar beneath it. In the background, a pirate statue and a graveyard scene complete the yard's festive decor.

replies.text: A skull archway AND a skeleton on guitar duty - this yard has a full production budget. The pirate running security in the back completes it.

nodes.snippet: Water Wednesday favorites 🏆 Three waters that stopped my sc…
nodes.text: Water Wednesday favorites 🏆 Three waters that stopped my scroll. @kes_ward @susannemariehelene @garnome - beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DezMhddjtMg/
photos: At the Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, a long exposure captures the ethereal, misty ocean lapping against the iconic, tightly packed hexagonal basalt columns under a dramatic, cloudy sky.

A macro shot shows a row of six clear, glistening water droplets balanced precariously along the edge of a vibrant green blade of grass, capturing the delicate beauty of a rainy morning. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blend of muted greens and whites, creating a serene and contemplative atmosphere.
A person wearing a hat pilots a small motorized dinghy through calm harbor waters, with a passenger resting nearby. In the background, numerous sailboats are anchored against a hazy shoreline.

replies.text: You said this one sits among your favorites - a 7am rise from the Causeway Hotel well spent. What earns it that spot? @kes_ward
Drops in perfect order. Did you find them lined up like that, or did the row form while you watched? @susannemariehelene
The dog at the bow - regular first mate, or a one-time passenger? @garnome

nodes.label: autumn, water, sky, leaves
nodes.snippet: Autumn Tuesday favorites 🏆 Three frames of fall that stoppe…
nodes.text: Autumn Tuesday favorites 🏆 Three frames of fall that stopped my scroll. @danielslagerman @pappaga11a @heidi.undefined - beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dewqqaoj2EX/
photos: An eye-level, medium shot depicts a dark wooden bench with concrete legs sitting on a small concrete platform facing a body of water during the autumn season. The sun is setting over the water, and its bright rays shine through the trees. The bare trees have brown and orange leaves, and a few are green. There are also yellow-green and green bushes. The ground is covered in brown and orange leaves and dirt.

Framed by the concrete pillars and metal railing of what appears to be a parking garage, a mature tree bursts with vibrant autumn foliage in shades of orange and red. The industrial architecture of the surrounding structure contrasts with the organic beauty of the changing leaves seen through the opening.
A fallen, brown autumn leaf rests on a bed of dewy grass, surrounded by a glistening field of water droplets that catch the light in a soft, dreamy blur.

replies.text: Is that bench a regular spot of yours, or a first find? @danielslagerman
Also from a parking garage - do you hunt frames there often, or did this one stop you mid-park? @pappaga11a
It sort of exists as a place that should have possibilities, but that moment caught me unexpectedly.
Takes a trained eye to notice 👍
You mentioned wet shoes hunting that morning light - how early were you out for this one? @heidi.undefined
Around 9:25 AM! Autumn sunrises are late here (around 8 AM), so 9:25 gave me the perfect morning light and dew 📸 (Shot on Nikon Z6 III, 105mm, f/5.6, 1/250s)
Perfectly calculated 👍👍👍

nodes.snippet: Water Wednesday 💧 Rivers, rain on glass, ocean edges, puddl…
nodes.text: Water Wednesday 💧 Rivers, rain on glass, ocean edges, puddles, fountains - show me water doing its thing. Framed this one through the railing at Niagara - the falls did the rest ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Best of the week lands on Instagram on the weekend.
photos: A framed view of Niagara Falls viewed through a metal spiral.
A scenic view shows a sunset over a river running along a city.

replies.text: A river borrowing the whole sunset. The city just watches from the banks.

photos: A picturesque coastal view on a clear, sunny day shows people gathered on a sandy beach next to a tranquil blue bay. In the background, lush green hills rise against a blue sky filled with wispy white clouds, while a few windsurfers navigate the calm waters.

replies.text: Beach full, bay calm, windsurfers on shift. That coastline does summer properly.
Beautiful Scotland
photos: A calm body of water perfectly reflects a majestic mountain landscape, with lush green foliage framing the foreground.

An eye-level, horizontal, wide shot displays a body of water in the foreground and a mountain covered in grass and rock in the background under a cloudy sky. The water in the foreground is calm and glassy with reflections of the mountain on the right and clouds above. The water has a light green and gray hue with reflections of the white and gray clouds above. The mountain is covered in patchy grass and crags of rock and stone. The top of the mountain is covered with a green and brown grass with hints of red-brown. The sky is filled with clouds that are tinged with yellow and white from the sun, which is behind the clouds.

A vibrant sunset casts warm orange and pink hues across a textured cloud-filled sky, reflecting on the calm water below. Rolling green hills line the horizon, while a rocky shoreline and grassy embankment frame the foreground.

A long shot captures the iconic Falkirk Wheel in Scotland, featuring its large, interlocking steel arches and their reflection in the calm water of the canal below. Tourists can be seen walking along the path, enjoying the architecture, under a grey, overcast sky.

replies.text: Four shots in and Scotland hasn't repeated itself once - mountain mirror, sunset, then the Falkirk Wheel. You packed a whole trip into one reply.

photos: A close-up shot captures several dew drops resting on the surface of a green plant leaf.

replies.text: Every drop a tiny lens. The leaf is doing all the posing here.

photos: A high-angle view captures a three-tiered waterfall flowing into a river on a bright, sunny day. The clear blue sky complements the natural landscape, featuring lush green trees on the banks, with a stone dam on the right side and stairs descending to the river on the left, where a few people walk.

replies.text: Three tiers, and the river takes them all in stride. Those stairs on the left get the best seat in the park.

photos: An older man and a young boy ride a water flume shaped like a hollowed-out log at Clacton Pier, with the man holding his arms up in the air and smiling. In the background, amusement park booths and a sign reading "Sweet Sensations" are visible.

replies.text: Arms up, full commitment - the log flume brings it out of everyone.
Namaskar Mahara🙏 from🇮🇳 kashmir

photos: A high-angle view captures a distant, rugged rock outcrop emerging from white-flecked, rolling blue waves of the ocean, framed by dense evergreen trees on the left and right.

replies.text: A rock outcrop holding its ground in all that blue. The evergreens framed the whole coastline for you.

photos: A low angle shot looks up through a glass window covered in water droplets against a bright blue sky with white clouds.

replies.text: Rain's leftovers on glass, blue sky behind them. The droplets kept the clouds' company and improved the view.
Botanical garden, Austin TX
photos: A small, tiered waterfall trickles down a rocky grotto, surrounded by lush green ferns and amber-toned foliage. The water collects in a shallow, algae-dappled pond at the base, creating a serene, natural sanctuary ideal for a mindful outdoor retreat.

replies.text: A grotto hiding in a botanical garden - ferns, amber leaves, and a waterfall that whispers. Austin keeps secrets.
Winter - Topsail Beach, NC
photos: A low-angle view captures a vast sandy beach where the wet sand reflects a dramatic sky filled with scattered white clouds and the golden light of a setting sun. In the distance, silhouetted against the horizon, a line of beachfront houses stands alongside gentle, rolling waves under a bright, expansive sky.

replies.text: Winter at Topsail - wet sand doing mirror work under that sky. The beach houses get a quiet season too.
#MahimbayMumbai #BandraWorliSeaLink, Mumbai 🇮🇳
▓Niagara Falls .. 2022 visit ▓▓
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows a bright blue sky above Niagara Falls in Ontario, Canada, with light mist rising up from the base of the waterfall to the right and a blue observation tower to the left of center. The water is clear blue, with the white spray of the falls cascading down over gray-colored rocks. The view from the water shows the observation tower on the left, which has a circular walkway at the top and a bridge extending to the main shoreline.

replies.text: Niagara from the waterline - tower watching, mist rising. Third falls framing in this thread today, and each one found a different angle.
We did the ‘Maid of the Mist🌫️’ & captured the falls 🤍 🌫️

photos: A low-riding small motorboat is wedged tightly under a concrete bridge with its top nearly touching the steel beam, creating an unexpectedly humorous parking spot. In the foreground, bright green leafy plants contrast with the calm, dark water of the canal.

replies.text: Precision parking. That boat is one inch of optimism away from a very bad day.

photos: A stunning mountain landscape features a calm lake in the foreground reflecting the bright daylight, with a dense forest of evergreen trees and bright yellow aspens blanketing the hillside. Towering, rugged mountain peaks with patches of rust-colored stone rise dramatically in the background beneath a blue sky filled with puffy white clouds.

replies.text: Aspens turning, peaks standing guard, lake holding the reflection. That's the full postcard stack.
Thanks! It’s Trout Lake in Colorado it’s near Telluride
Where the calm sea meets the rugged coastline. 🌊🤍 I love the contrast between the gentle water and the dramatic textures of the rocks.

photos: A high-angle close-up shows vibrant, rich, deep crimson red Japanese maple leaves covered in clear water droplets against a blurry green background.

replies.text: Crimson, beaded, and unreasonably rich. The droplets are doing fine jewelry work.
Isfahan, Iran. Always wonder about her story and her thoughts as she watched the river.
photos: A woman dressed in a black abaya and hijab sits on stone steps, looking down at churning white water as the sun glistens across the surface.

replies.text: Some photos ask a question and leave it open. She sat with that river a while, by the look of it.
Whistler, Wasaga Beach, Niagara Falls 🌊💙

photos: A rushing, churning river flows through a rocky canyon, its white-capped rapids creating a sense of powerful motion. The steep, dry hillsides are dotted with evergreen trees and sparse vegetation, capturing a rugged wilderness landscape.

replies.text: That river is not asking the canyon's permission. White water the whole way down?

photos: A low-angle, vertical shot captures a rocky beach foreground with glistening wet pebbles and sand reflecting the bright sun just above the horizon. In the background, calm ocean waves gently wash ashore under a dramatic sky filled with scattered, dark clouds lit by the sun's rays.

replies.text: Glistening pebbles, low sun, storm clouds arguing overhead. Low angles win again.
Barbados yesterday
photos: Two tall palm trees sway against a bright blue sky filled with fluffy white clouds, with turquoise ocean waves gently rolling onto the shore below.

replies.text: Barbados yesterday - turquoise doing its usual showing off. Hard to take a bad photo there; harder to take one this clean.
View from the pool at the Coconut Court Beach Hotel. Was lovely.

photos: A green iron railing frames a scenic view of a lake dotted with fish pens, set against a backdrop of rolling, green hills under a partly cloudy sky. The eye-level perspective makes the landscape feel open and inviting, perfect for an outdoor travel post.

replies.text: A railing, a lake, and fish pens dotting the middle distance. Framed like a postcard someone actually sends.
Thank you for the appreciation! ▓

photos: A serene daytime view of a tranquil river in the foreground, with the skyline of a city including a tall residential building reflected on the water's calm surface under a clear sky.
A serene lake view with green grass and rocks along the shore. The far shore has a dense line of trees under a clear blue sky.

replies.text: Two calm waters - the city one with its skyline doubled is my pick. Same day out or two favorites?

photos: A serene lake view is framed by trees with autumn leaves in shades of red, green, and gold against a clear blue sky. The water reflects the vibrant foliage, making it a peaceful spot for a scenic nature walk or an autumn day outdoors.

replies.text: Autumn trees leaning in to frame their own reflection. The lake just had to hold still.

photos: A waterfall cascades over a rocky ledge into a churning pool, with a forested hillside and a bridge visible in the background under a clear blue sky.
A powerful waterfall cascades through rugged, layered rock formations framed by evergreen trees and autumn foliage. In the background, a turquoise river flows past a dense forest under a clear sky.

replies.text: Two falls for the price of one - the layered-rock one with the turquoise river behind it is a stunner. Same hike?
Both in Alberta . First one Lundbreck Falls. Second is Athabasca Falls . Definitely not the same hike! Athabasca is my favorite
photos: A powerful waterfall crashes over layered, grey rock formations into a vibrant, turquoise river, with a dense green forest and a towering, rugged mountain under a clear blue sky in the background.

replies.text: Athabasca takes the favorite title - turquoise river, layered rock, mountain behind it. Lundbreck put up a good fight, though.

photos: A vertical, eye-level, slightly upward shot captures the front of the San Pedro Cathedral in Davao City, Philippines. The cathedral, built in the Spanish colonial revival style, features a pale-yellow façade with pink accents and a multi-tiered bell tower on the left. The front of the cathedral is reflected in a large puddle in the foreground.

A lonely dog sits in silhouette on a wet beach, gazing out toward a vibrant red sun setting over the ocean. The serene scene is filled with warm, soft light reflected in the damp sand and gentle waves.

A vibrant, sunlit view shows a tranquil infinity pool overlooking a sprawling lake surrounded by lush green hills under a bright, cloudy sky. The glistening water creates a shimmering reflection that stretches across the vast lake, capturing a serene and picturesque tropical landscape.

A serene body of water stretches towards a range of distant, arid mountains under a pale blue sky with scattered clouds. A small boat with an outrigger floats peacefully on the right side of the frame, with a timestamp in the bottom right corner reading "2022.06.07 06:26".

replies.text: Four waters, but the cathedral standing in a puddle wins it for me. Davao after rain hands out free mirrors.

photos: A vibrant sunset casts an orange glow across a calm expanse of water, with the sun dipping just below the distant horizon. Wispy clouds float overhead, tinged with pink and gold from the fading light.

replies.text: The sun clocking out over flat-calm water. Some evenings don't need anything else in the frame.

photos: A woman with dark hair and tattoos on her arms is captured in mid-motion against a black background, with dynamic splashes of water surrounding her body. The dramatic lighting casts a reddish glow on her lower body as she strikes an expressive pose.

replies.text: Water as a dance partner - those splashes froze mid-choreography. Studio work?
They're frozen with the strobe lighting, thrown by an assistant. Couldn't believe it looked like a pink Tutu. 😁

photos: A close-up shot captures vibrant purple lilac blossoms glistening with fresh morning rain droplets. The blurred green background enhances the focus on the delicate, dewy petals, creating a serene and refreshing spring aesthetic.

replies.text: Lilacs beaded with rain - the droplets are your water entry, and they qualify easily.
Thank you

photos: A scenic shot of a rushing river in the woods, with exposed tree roots framing the rocky foreground and autumn foliage beginning to show on the trees across the water.

replies.text: Roots doing the framing, river doing the rushing. Autumn just starting to sign the trees across the water.

photos: A stunning sunset paints the sky in vibrant shades of pink and purple over a calm ocean, silhouetting a dreamcatcher, a boat, and figures on the shore.

replies.text: A dreamcatcher, a boat, and that pink sky - the shore staged the whole scene for you.

That was on Koh Lipe, my favorite island out of four months total in Thailand. It was simple huts twenty years ago with footpaths thru the jungle connecting the three beaches. Satellite views now show it completely developed with large resorts. It was special. Went to a Thai funeral on the mainland with the owner of the bungalows.
photos: A satellite map of Koh Lipe, Thailand, displaying local points of interest such as resorts, beaches, and bars.

replies.text: Twenty years from huts and jungle footpaths to a satellite full of resorts. The sunset you kept is the version that stays yours.
It’s happened to three of my absolute favorite places; Koh Lipe in Thailand, Isla Holbox in MX and Jericocoara in Brasil.
But yes, I treasure my time there and the relationships made..
Downtown Spokane
photos: A wide-angle, eye-level shot captures a river flowing under a road bridge on a sunny day. The river has rapids in the foreground and a calm stretch in the background, where a large, dark rock sits in the middle. The banks are lined with lush green trees and shrubs, with buildings and a pavilion visible on the right. The clear blue sky is filled with fluffy white clouds, and the bright sunlight sparkles on the water's surface, creating a peaceful and scenic atmosphere.

An eye-level shot captures a large concrete bridge spanning a river in a bustling city. The bridge features numerous arches and pillars, and spans across a river flowing between rocky banks covered with autumn foliage, with a city skyline visible in the distance under a blue sky dotted with white clouds.

replies.text: Spokane showing both its moods - rapids up front, the arched bridge for the portrait. Sunny day well spent.
Downtown Spokane is quite a nice place. Are there still a lot of goose there?
Takakkaw Falls..
photos: A towering waterfall plunges down a sheer, rocky cliff face into a rushing, glacier-fed river below. The landscape is framed by evergreen trees and autumn-tinted foliage, creating a serene wilderness scene.

replies.text: Takakkaw doing its tower impression. Glacier-fed and in a hurry about it.

photos: A black-and-white high-angle medium shot of an older couple in a rowboat with the man rowing.

replies.text: An older couple, a rowboat, black and white - some photos just slow you down.
Rowing her out into a boat in the harbor, and back, in the rain, that’s love
Rowing her out and back in the rain - you're right, that's the caption the photo deserved.

photos: An abandoned brick building covered in vines sits beside a river, with a large rusted bridge spanning the water in the background. The surreal color palette of vibrant red foliage and cyan water creates an eerie, almost apocalyptic atmosphere.

replies.text: Red foliage, cyan water, a building the vines reclaimed - that palette went full otherworld. Infrared or an edit with nerve?
Cedarburg Creek Waterfall in downtown behind the shops
photos: A wide, man-made dam spans a winding river, creating a gentle waterfall surrounded by lush green trees on a bright afternoon. The calm water reflects the surrounding foliage, with homes faintly visible in the background.

replies.text: A waterfall hiding behind the shops - downtown's worst-kept secret, apparently. Worth ducking behind the stores for.
Yes! Most of Cedarburg,WI looks like a fairy tale no matter where you go. It's a must see town in Wisconsin

photos: An adult black swan leads a line of five fluffy grey cygnets across a calm lake at dusk, with the distant city skyline silhouetted against a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Five cygnets in single file behind mum. The dusk patrol runs a tight ship.
Rainy day sunset
photos: A misty landscape of bare trees is viewed through a window covered in raindrops, creating a textured, moody scene. A warm, golden glow peeks through the horizon at the base of the trees.

replies.text: Rain on the window, sunset behind the trees - two weathers in one frame.

photos: A serene dusk view features the city skyline of Roermond reflected on the still surface of the Maas River, with a pink-toned sky above.

A serene landscape shot captures a vibrant sunset casting a warm golden and purple glow over a city skyline and a calm river, creating a clear mirror reflection. The horizon is filled with silhouettes of buildings, trees, and a distant church tower, with a watermark in the bottom left corner reading "Maurice Vergoossen."

A wide-angle, eye-level shot captures a city skyline across a body of water under a pale, overcast sky. The skyline features a variety of architectural styles, including a tall, slender church steeple on the left, a pyramidal building in the center, and a modern communication tower on the right, all reflecting softly in the water's surface. In the bottom left corner, the name "Maurice Vergoossen" is written in a stylized white font.

A high-angle, wide shot shows a sunset over the city skyline of Roermond in the Netherlands, viewed across a grassy field and a river. The skyline is dominated by a modern skyscraper with two distinct conical peaks on the left, next to the towering spire of Roermond's historic cathedral. Other modern residential and office buildings line the riverbank. The sky is a mix of pale blue and pink clouds.

replies.text: Four mornings of Roermond on the Maas - the river hands you a different mirror every day. The cathedral spire reflection is my favorite of the set.

..Yes.., It is mine too.. With on top of the Saint Christopher Cathedral the statue of Saint Christopher with Jesus Christ held in his right hand, watching over the city and the river Meuse.. Saint Christopher is the keeper of the city of Roermond.. It is a beautiful building to see from outside as from inside, with its restored brand glasses..
..My hometown Roermond, The Netherlands, among the river Meuse due sunrise, Photographed during several days this year..

photos: A distant thunderstorm looms over a low mountain range, with grey storm clouds and rain shafts visible against a pale sky. The low foreground features a paved road edge and sparse desert brush, suggesting a remote southwestern landscape.

replies.text: Rain falling over the desert, still miles from reaching you. Storm-watching from dry ground is the best seat.
Ice ice baby
photos: An intricate pattern of frost covers a glass window, creating delicate, fern-like ice crystals across the pane. Faint, blurred lights glow through the partially obscured glass, suggesting a chilly evening or early morning scene.

replies.text: Frost ferns on glass - winter drawing on the window again. Ice ice baby indeed.

photos: A high-angle shot captures two people paddling a red canoe on a tranquil body of water under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground shows mossy rocks emerging from the water.

replies.text: A red canoe from above, mossy rocks standing guard. Were you in the second boat?
No, I was on the land. It was a summer evening on Loch Eil. Here’s more from that evening.
photos: A bright blue and white boat and a red canoe rest on the shore of a wide lake under a dramatic, cloudy sky.
A couple in a red canoe sets off from a grassy, seaweed-strewn shore into a calm body of water, with distant tree-covered hills and mountains under a partly cloudy sky.

A serene vertical landscape features a calm, reflective body of water stretching toward distant, hazy mountains under a soft twilight sky. Framed by dark green foliage in the foreground, the tranquil scene evokes a peaceful evening by a Scottish loch.

A serene sunset paints the sky in soft golden hues above a calm lake, with silhouetted mountains in the background. In the foreground, two canoes rest on a concrete pier next to a small motorboat docked in the shallow water.

replies.text: The whole Loch Eil evening, unspooled - boats ashore, the couple setting off, then that twilight. You shot the whole story from the land, start to finish.

photos: A close-up shot captures a series of six dew drops sitting on a vibrant green blade of grass, reflecting light and the environment around them. The background is softly blurred, highlighting the delicate water droplets and the texture of the leaf.

replies.text: Six drops in a row, each holding its own little reflection. Patience or luck to catch them lined up like that?
A bit of both I guess, I’ve got so many pictures of drops in my gallery

photos: A sun-drenched mountain stream flows through a lush, green valley at sunset, with light rays piercing through the sky. Distant rolling hills and sparse trees frame the tranquil wilderness scene.

replies.text: A stream with its own sunbeams. You keep finding the right light today.
Weekapaug Pond, Westerly RI
photos: A tranquil body of water mirrors a dramatic sunset with pink and orange clouds, while two weathered wooden pilings rise from the calm surface. In the distance, a coastline featuring a row of houses silhouettes against the vibrant evening sky.

replies.text: Two old pilings standing in a sunset mirror. Weekapaug showing off for you.
Lake 12,000 ft elevation on the continental divide.
photos: A frozen pond and snow-covered landscape under a gray, overcast sky evoke a quiet winter mood. Patches of brown, frost-dusted grass poke through the snow in the foreground, adding a touch of texture to the cold, stark scenery.

replies.text: Twelve thousand feet and already frozen over. Winter starts early at that altitude.

photos: A two-panel vertical shot captures a humpback whale diving, with its dark, sleek back surfacing in the upper frame and its massive flukes—dripping with water—breaking the calm sea's surface in the lower frame.

replies.text: Back, then flukes - the full dive in two frames. Right place, or were you tracking it?
I was at the right place at the right time

photos: A close-up shot captures several vibrant red roses, their petals glistening with countless sparkling raindrops. The soft-focus background highlights the rich, dewy texture of the flowers, creating a serene and refreshing morning garden scene.

replies.text: Roses after rain, still beaded. Your garden showing off on a schedule?

photos: A golden sun sets over a tranquil river, casting a warm orange glow across the sky and reflecting on the water's smooth surface. Silhouetted trees and grassy banks frame the scenic view, creating a peaceful and serene atmosphere.

replies.text: The river caught the whole sunset. Evenings like that make the walk worth it.
Oh, that was sunrise…and so worth it! It’s part of why I take my phone on runs. This was my other favorite from that moment.
photos: A spider waits in the center of its intricately woven web against the backdrop of a vibrant sunset over a rural landscape. The low evening sun casts a golden glow, silhouetting the spider and illuminating the delicate threads of the web.

replies.text: Sun rise it is 🤭 great golden hour shots! Both of them 👍

photos: A traditional Viking longship rests peacefully on calm blue waters, moored near a scenic, grassy coastline.

replies.text: A longship at rest. Replica out for a sail, or a working boat?

photos: A dusk-lit landscape shows a wooden bridge leading towards a serene lake, reflecting the warm glow of distant illuminated buildings on the far shore under a blue twilight sky.

A picturesque waterfall flows into a tranquil pool surrounded by lush green foliage, with people enjoying the water and rocks on a sunny day. The dreamy, tilt-shift effect highlights the serene nature scene, making it an idyllic spot for a summer getaway.
A bright sun sets or rises over a tranquil, dark ocean, casting a golden glow across the water and clouds in a peaceful seascape.

replies.text: Three waters, three moods - the dusk bridge is my pick. That far shore glows like it's expecting company.

This is Punderson Lake, Punderson State Park, Newbury, Ohio. On that far shore is what’s known as Punderson Manor, a former mansion that was converted in a resort hotel - so, yes, they’re expecting people. 😉
lol thanks for sharing!
Rain ...
photos: A vertical, high-angle, long shot of a wet asphalt road, pavement, and crosswalk with white painted lines that reflect the city's yellow and white streetlights in the dark night. The light from a streetlamp at the upper right creates an ethereal lens flare that stretches from its source to the lamp post in the right foreground. The lamp post is covered in stickers and a street sign points to the right. Beyond the glistening road, the city is lit up with streetlights and illuminated signs on the buildings, including one in red with the letters OSP.

replies.text: Rain turned the whole street into a mirror with traffic lines. That flare earned its keep.
I’ll offer this one of a fairly well-known waterfall.
photos: A full-vertical, eye-level shot captures a vibrant, green-hued Niagara Falls in the distance, partially framed by bare, brown tree branches in the upper foreground. A white, misty cloud rises from the base of the falls, partially obscuring the water. In the lower right corner, a red boat can be seen sailing on the water, while tall green grass and a few leafy bushes grow in the lower foreground. The sky is bright blue with white, fluffy clouds, creating a clear and sunny day.

replies.text: The famous one, and it still lands - falls, mist, and the little red boat for scale. Some views earn their reputation.

photos: A rainy city street view through a window, with blurry skyscrapers and warm bokeh lights creating a cozy mood.

replies.text: Rainy glass, warm bokeh - the coziest way to watch a city get wet.
It was raining cats and dogs
photos: Heavy rain and sleet fall across a grassy courtyard in front of a European-style estate featuring stone walls and yellow dog statues.

replies.text: Raining cats and dogs, and the courtyard has actual dog statues standing guard. They look thrilled about it.
Troll Falls, Kananaskis Alberta, Canada
photos: A vibrant waterfall plunges over a rocky ledge, framed by tall evergreen trees in a dense forest with a bright sun peaking through. The base of the waterfall is partially covered in melting snow, suggesting an early spring or late winter setting.

replies.text: Troll Falls with snow still at its feet. Spring there takes its time leaving.

It's also in the shade, so it takes quite a long time. This was mid-May. My kids took me on a hike out here for Mother's Day. You used to be able to walk behind the falls (I have) but theyve blocked it off now.
A Mother's Day hike to a falls you once walked behind - that's a full-circle photo. Glad the shade keeps it lingering.

photos: A group of people relax in a steaming geothermal lagoon under a bright, sunny sky with wispy clouds, surrounded by dark volcanic rock formations. The low sun creates a lens flare on the water's surface, highlighting the serene atmosphere.

replies.text: A lagoon with steam for a roof. Hard to call that a hardship.
It was my wife’s 60th birthday so I had to take her somewhere nice for a treat
A 60th done properly. She picked well - so did you, bringing her there.

photos: A high-contrast black-and-white photo features a lone boater cruising in a small inflatable dinghy across calm harbor waters. In the background, several sailboats rest at anchor under a hazy sky, with a low-slung shoreline visible in the distance.

replies.text: Black and white suits that little dinghy - one boat moving, the rest all patience.

photos: A wide shot captures a coastal slipway on an overcast day, with people gathered on the pier and swimming in the dark water. In the distance, flat-topped mountains rise across the bay beneath a dramatic sky heavy with clouds.

replies.text: Swimmers, a slipway, and mountains holding the backdrop. Cold water, warm scene?

Well the kids were wearing wet suits. Sligo coast, NW Ireland, North Atlantic Ocean. I swam in the Irish Sea as a kid with no wet suit & I think it was warmer than the water off Vancouver Island, British Columbia.

photos: A vertical shot features thin streams of water pouring from a stone ledge into a fountain pool below, each stream creating expanding concentric ripples. Scattered autumn leaves rest on the stone ledge and in the water near the right edge of the frame.

replies.text: Every stream drawing its own ripple circles. The autumn leaves in the pool clocked the season too.
Lake Michigan 😎❣️
photos: A small wave breaks along the sandy shoreline under a bright sky. In the distance, a dark breakwater cuts across the water beneath a horizon line that meets the pale clouds.

replies.text: Lake Michigan doing its ocean impression again. That little wave landed right on cue.

photos: A close-up shot captures a cluster of green and reddish leaves, heavily speckled with dew drops, glistening under the natural light. The background is softly blurred with hints of other foliage, creating a serene and natural ambiance ideal for a nature-loving post.

replies.text: Dew on every leaf like it was placed there. Early round or a lucky window?
The water of the Erie Canal, reflecting the lights of Schoen Place at blue hour.
photos: A high-angle twilight shot shows a calm river mirroring the warm lights of a waterfront town in Pittsford, New York, captured by Charles O. Perez. The tranquil scene features a tall, slender grain elevator on the left, boats moored along the banks, and a deep blue sky transitioning into dusk.

replies.text: Blue hour on the canal, every light doubled. Pittsford knows how to dress for dusk.

photos: An icy rock, resembling a frozen phoenix rising from dark blue water, rests in the middle of a river. The river bank is covered in white snow, emphasizing the cold, wintery environment.

replies.text: A frozen phoenix parked mid-river. Winter leaves the strangest sculptures behind.
Here is another one. Human-shaped cracks in the river ice.
photos: A long, narrow crack cuts through a snow-covered field at night, illuminated faintly by distant city lights on the horizon. The dark shadows flanking the crevice give it an eerie, volcanic appearance, perfect for a moody nature post.

replies.text: Oh, I had to watch it twice. I thought they were real human shadow. Lol.😂
After an hour they looked like this, it was snowing and snow gradually covered them.
photos: A high angle shot at dusk shows a partially frozen body of water. The melting ice forms abstract patterns that look like a person riding a surfboard or a manta ray. The distant shore has distant lights, and the sky is a dark gray.

replies.text: Cool. Thanks for sharing it.
Yes...winter is doing its magic.

photos: A close-up vertical shot of two glistening water droplets clinging to the tips of a vibrant green leaf, illuminated by sunlight.

replies.text: Two droplets, perfectly balanced on the leaf tips. They held still for you beautifully.

photos: A night shot captures a starry sky over a body of water, with a rocky shoreline in the foreground. A few faint lights twinkle on the horizon across the water.

replies.text: Stars over water, shore in silhouette - the quietest photo in today's thread.

photos: A wide-angle, slightly low-angle, eye-level shot captures a moody, overcast day along the water. In the background, across a wide body of water, a cluster of smokestacks from a power plant or industrial facility billows white smoke into the dramatic gray clouds. To the left, a line of tall trees with hints of changing autumn colors edges the shoreline, which is a mix of dirt, rocks, and a concrete boat ramp in the foreground. On the right, a tall, white concrete or metal pole stands upright, stretching vertically into the frame. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by grays, browns, and dull greens under a heavy, overcast sky.
This vertical shot shows a calm river under a bright blue sky, with three white pillars on a concrete bank to the right and lush green trees casting dappled shadows on the ground to the left.

replies.text: Two rivers, two tempers - the industry shot has real mood to it. Same stretch of water or two different days?
Great Falls Virginia USA
photos: A vertical, eye-level shot captures a river rushing through a rocky landscape on a bright, sunny day, with a line of lush green trees on the horizon under a clear blue sky. White foam crests the dark water as it tumbles over jagged gray boulders, highlighting the powerful currents.

replies.text: Great Falls earning the name - that water is in a hurry. Loud spot to stand?
Not loud but interesting to watch a kayak paddling against current
photos: A lone kayaker navigates the swift, choppy waters of a wide river, dwarfed by towering, craggy rock formations along the bank. Lush green foliage frames the scene from the foreground and the forested hills above under a bright sky.

replies.text: Not loud, but that kayaker is earning every meter against that current. One paddler vs Great Falls - respect.

photos: A calm, shallow body of water flows toward the ocean between a rocky, tree-lined cliff on the left and a sandy beach on the right, under a partly cloudy blue sky. A few people can be seen in the distance on the black rocks where the river meets the sea.

replies.text: A stream clocking out into the ocean. Best of both waters in one frame.

photos: A bright, overcast sky casts a silvery glare over rippling water, with distant land visible on the horizon. In the foreground, a dark stone sea wall lines a paved path, creating a tranquil coastal scene.

replies.text: Silver light on rippled water, not a soul in frame. The sea wall path all to yourself?
I’m always careful to exclude other people unless they’re friends of mine.

photos: A rusted, old iron anchor lies on a grassy hill, with a stone wall to its left and the sea in the background. Framing the view through the anchor's loop, a distant lighthouse stands on a pier under a partly cloudy sky.

replies.text: Framed the lighthouse through the anchor's loop - today's cleverest frame. Did you spot the trick walking up, or only at the anchor?
Thank you - I took another shot of the anchor looking the other way, turned around and saw the framing possibility! A bit of luck, I guess!
photos: A large, rusty iron anchor is mounted on a stone pedestal in an outdoor setting under a cloudy sky. In the background, a tall, thin stone chimney stands atop a green hill, suggesting a coastal industrial heritage site.

replies.text: Maybe lucky, it still takes the eye of noticing. Nice shot! 👍

photos: A long-exposure photograph captures the moody atmosphere of the Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, where iconic hexagonal basalt columns emerge from a misty, glass-like sea under a twilight sky.

replies.text: beautiful long exposure
Thank you so much. 🙏 It’s sits amongst my favourite images. Was a very early rise to capture this one.
Basalt columns walking straight into a glassy sea. Does the Causeway ever get a quiet evening, or did you win the timing lottery?
That was about 7am give or take. I was staying in the Causeway Hotel right by it. I love an early rise for photography. My favourite time of day.

photos: A vibrant golden sunset filters through the silhouettes of tall pine trees, casting a warm glow over a serene lake. In the foreground, fallen pine needles scatter across the ground, completing this picturesque, peaceful nature scene.

replies.text: Sunset doing all the work through those pines. Is that a local lake or a found one?
Actually, it’s the Saco River in Dayton, Maine.
A river wearing a lake's disguise - fair correction. Light like that earns the disguise.

photos: A high-angle, vertical shot captures lily pads and tiny yellow flowers scattered across the dark water of a pond. The water surface reflects the blue sky, creating a peaceful atmosphere.
A tranquil stream flows through a lush autumn forest, its banks lined with vibrant yellow and red foliage. Fallen leaves cover the ground, creating a serene and picturesque seasonal landscape.

A long stone and stucco bridge spans a calm body of water, featuring a row of arched openings along the lower level and rectangular windows on the upper floor, with its architecture clearly mirrored on the glassy water's surface beneath a bright blue sky.

replies.text: Three for one - the bridge with its mirror twin is my pick of the set. Where is that? It looks purpose-built for reflections.
Location is Strasbourg France. Last year on one of our trips.

photos: Framed by the cutouts of a white concrete wall, a motorboat speeds across sparkling blue water under a bright sky with scattered clouds.

replies.text: A boat, framed by the wall itself. Did you spot the cutout first or the boat?
I spotted the cut out first and was trying to capture the symmetry and fortunately the boat started coming across so I waited until I got centered
Cutout first, then patience until the boat centered itself - the plan worked exactly as drawn.
Thank you, Saar!
You are welcome

photos: A serene alpine lake reflects a dense forest of evergreen trees and a clear blue sky, framed by gentle mountain slopes under bright daylight.

replies.text: The lake doubling the whole forest. Windless mornings like that feel rigged.

photos: Waves gently lap against a rugged, rocky shoreline bordering a vibrant turquoise sea. In the distance, two small sailboats are visible on the horizon under a clear sky.

replies.text: Turquoise like that should require a permit. Local shore or a trip?
Trip to Key West! Amazing!!
Key West is amazing. I have been there once and it was a great place.

photos: A low-angle, eye-level shot looks through splashing water at the Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna, Austria, with tourists walking through its grand, flower-lined gardens in the distance. The bright daylight is slightly obscured by the water's mist, while the sky above is mostly blue with scattered fluffy white clouds.

replies.text: Shot through the spray, palace and all. Did the lens stay dry?
Shot with just a phone camera. There is a little space behind the fountain that I found with the view of the palace. Most people wander by without knowing it’s there.
The quiet of a Muskoka evening
photos: A small boat rests tied to a wooden dock on a calm lake, with another dock visible further out. The sun breaks through dramatic, scattered clouds at sunset, casting a golden reflection on the water's surface.

replies.text: Muskoka evenings showing off again. That boat has the best seat in Ontario.

photos: A high-angle view from a hot air balloon basket captures a winding river flowing through a dry, scrubby landscape under a clear blue sky. Vertical red and black straps hang in the foreground, framing the serene aerial view.

A man wearing a dark baseball cap and an olive green hoodie looks out from a hot air balloon basket at a winding river below, flanked by grassy banks. The bright blue sky and clear weather suggest an ideal morning for a scenic flight.

replies.text: A river from a balloon basket beats any window seat. Was the landing as graceful as the view?
A tiny bit scrappy but nothing major. So much fun though!!!!!❤️❤️❤️❤️
Hahaha, good experience 👍

photos: A wide, ice-covered river winds through a dense, snow-dusted forest of evergreen and deciduous trees on an overcast winter day. In the foreground, vibrant red branches reach up from the bank, adding a pop of color to the monochromatic landscape.

replies.text: The red branches refusing to do winter quietly. Frozen solid, or still moving under the ice?
There’s still water moving under the ice.
So cool 👍

photos: A vibrant, magenta water lily floats on the dark, reflective surface of a pond, nestled between two large, bright green lily pads. In the background, a scattered field of lily pads creates a peaceful, sunlit nature scene.

replies.text: That magenta is not being subtle about anything. Your pond or a garden visit?
Just a lake we were kayaking on ❤️￼

photos: A large suspension bridge spans across calm water at sunset, with a white, green, and blue ferry crossing beneath its towers. Hilly terrain is visible in the background under a pale yellow sky.

replies.text: The ferry timed its crossing perfectly for you. Planned, or right place, right minute?
Rather, I'm in the right place at the right time, everything came together: sunset, bridge, ferry, ocean and San Francisco
Sometimes all the elements just fall into place. You were there to catch the magic! 👍

photos: A grey heron takes flight across a serene pond, its wings spread wide as it skims just above the reflective water surface. The peaceful scene is set against a backdrop of bare winter trees under a clear blue sky, capturing a quiet moment in nature.

replies.text: Caught it mid-launch, wings already committed. Reflexes or patience?
Neither really , I was taking a picture of the reflection and the bird photobombed me
Haaa, he wanted to be in the nice shot 🤭
Barden Lake, Tonbridge, Kent, UK.
photos: A high-angle, eye-level shot captures a vibrant body of water under a clear blue sky, with a lush, green island in the distance. The shoreline in the foreground teems with a lively gathering of ducks and birds, their feathers gleaming in the bright sunlight.

replies.text: The whole duck committee showed up. Is that a daily summit at Barden Lake?

Yes, to discuss action to be taken on unseasonably low water levels, green algae from local agriculture and worst of all the idiotic local fishermen who are somehow allowed to throw sharp hooks on thin nylon lines into the water. The Duck Committee also has coots, moorhens and various geese and swans as honorary members.
The Duck Committee's agenda is more serious than most council meetings. Honored to hear coots get seats.
Nerano, Italy. On the Sorrento Peninsula. Tuesday (yesterday) morning) 😁
photos: A high angle shot captures a pebble beach with a small pier, with several small boats floating in the water. The sun sets behind a lush, dark green hill with buildings on it, illuminating the sea with a soft glow.

replies.text: Shot yesterday morning and already looking like a postcard. Worth the early alarm?
Absolutely!!

photos: An abstract view of ripples moving across clear water, with reflections of trees and rocks underneath.

replies.text: Pure ripples, no subject needed. Hard to stop watching these once you start.
Cinque Terre Italy
photos: (description unavailable: blocked by Gemini, reason: PROHIBITED_CONTENT)
Two fishermen stand on a dark, sandy beach with sparse vegetation, casting lines into a vast ocean with frothy, white-capped waves blurred by long exposure.

replies.text: Two fishermen, and a sea doing its best impression of the sky. That long exposure turned the surf into clouds - I had to look twice.
Many attemots made as the fishermen kept moving. Shot from a kilometer away on a 300mm
That’s how much effort for a nice picture

photos: A close-up shot of water droplets on a smooth surface against a gray background, creating a moody, contemplative atmosphere.

replies.text: Droplets doing minimalism. A whole subject in a puddle's worth of water.

photos: A lone fisherman stands on a wet sandy beach at sunset, with two fishing rods propped up next to a bucket and the ocean in the background. The sky is painted with vibrant orange and pink hues, creating a serene and picturesque coastal scene.

replies.text: One fisherman, two rods, and that sky. Did the fish cooperate at all?
Probably not 🤣

photos: At dusk, several boats are docked in a harbor, with their bright lights reflecting on the dark water.

replies.text: Harbor lights doubled on the water. Dusk is that place's best hour.
Dusk is a really great time for photos . It’s not always calm at the harbor . I’m glad you liked my photo .

photos: A man calmly reads a newspaper on a bench with his feet dangling in the flooded water of the River Thames. Nearby, several seagulls perch on wooden posts, unbothered by the high water level.

replies.text: Feet in the Thames, paper in hand, completely unbothered - him and the gulls both. Is that a regular high-tide ritual there?

photos: A brilliant yellow sunset dips below a distant coastline, its last rays casting a warm glow across a dark, choppy body of water.

replies.text: Last rays over choppy water. The day went out swinging.
Jesus 🙏🙏❤️❤️ God bless you and your family, thank you

photos: A solitary bird flies across the frame as the sun sets over a calm harbor, illuminating a large, dramatic cloud formation in the background. The golden light reflects off the water, highlighting a wooden pier and a small building in the distance.

replies.text: The bird crossed right on cue. That cloud was doing enough drama for the whole harbor.

photos: A vertically-oriented, medium close-up shot captures several icicles hanging from the branches of a pine tree covered in snow. The icicles in the foreground are sharp and clear, while those in the background are blurred. The pine tree's needles are covered in a light layer of snow, and the icicles hang vertically from the branches. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the icicles and the snow-covered pine needles.

replies.text: Water Wednesday, frozen edition. Those icicles are sharper than the pine needles.
Great framing

photos: A close-up shot captures scattered raindrops glistening on a dark, wet surface. The background features a softly blurred, abstract scene with hints of blue, green, and orange.

replies.text: Raindrops doing their glisten. What surface caught them this well?
These are glazed tiles on a terrace.

photos: Two people are standing on a rocky beach on an overcast day, surrounded by driftwood and water.
A tour boat packed with sightseers framed by the twisted metal scroll of a railing overlooking the churning waters of Niagara Falls.
Raindrops create overlapping concentric ripples on the surface of a shallow puddle on grey concrete.

replies.text: The Niagara boat framed by that railing scroll - I know that trick, I used it for today's hero. Great minds at the same railing?

photos: A wide-angle, low-angle, eye-level, horizontal shot captures a motorized boat with a simple roof canopy sitting on deep blue water, silhouetted against a bright sunrise, in Baja, Mexico. The boat is positioned on the right third of the frame, facing left. The sun shines brightly in the upper left corner, casting rays across the blue sky and water. Gentle ripples cover the water's surface, reflecting the sunlight. Silhouetted figures are visible in the boat, with one person in the front and two or three at the back. Far in the distance on the left, a light-colored mountain range is faintly visible under the hazy sky.

replies.text: Baja sunrise, boat silhouetted, sun doing the spotlight work. You collect good mornings.
Superb!
Rain on the screen
photos: A bright golden light shines through a rain-streaked window, illuminating water droplets against a dark, tree-lined backdrop. The distorted view creates an abstract, fiery effect from the light filtering through the wet glass.

replies.text: Rain on the screen turned the light into fire. Inside looking out never looked warmer.

nodes.label: autumn, water, sky, leaves
nodes.snippet: Autumn Tuesday 🍂 Show me your best autumn shot. Red trees, …
nodes.text: Autumn Tuesday 🍂 Show me your best autumn shot. Red trees, golden leaves, foggy mornings, pumpkins, whatever fall looks like where you are. Caught this one from a parking garage - autumn framing the view. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Follow for more prompts.
photos: A view of a foggy autumn day featuring vibrant red ivy framing a window opening. The misty background reveals tall evergreen and deciduous trees against a muted gray sky.
A multi-story stone building features ivy transitioning from green to red. Cars park along the street in front of the building.

replies.text: An autumn in a dream! How did you shoot this? Is that a special kind of lens?
I took this photo with an ancient Android phone where you could set this kind of blur effect in the camera.
I see. Quite a fit for the scene!

photos: A high-angle view captures a winding stream flowing through a rocky gorge in autumn, its banks and ledges blanketed with vibrant yellow and orange fallen leaves. Several people stand on a stone pathway carved into the cliffside in the upper right, admiring the scenic landscape.

replies.text: A gorge dressed head to toe in fall. Did you hike down to the stream, or is the cliff path the best seat?
The cliff path and steps to the path.
Door Co., WI
photos: A low-angle view captures a forest canopy in peak autumn color, with vibrant orange, red, and yellow leaves illuminated by the morning sun. Beams of sunlight pierce through the trees, casting a warm, glowing light on the forest floor below.

replies.text: Peak color from underneath - the canopy doing its stained-glass impression. How long did that light hold?
Not long at all. Pictures like this remind me of how light will maybe be that way for a short time and the picture I got will never be taken again.

photos: A serene landscape photo captures a lake reflecting a cloudy blue sky under dramatic, puffy clouds. In the background, a line of trees adorned with autumn foliage stands tall, while tall grass peeks through the water in the foreground, enhancing the natural beauty of the scene.

replies.text: Clouds doing double duty - once in the sky, once on the water. Did the lake stay that calm, or catch this in a lucky pause?
Very early in the morning before it got wavy!
Great effort!

photos: A rustic, weathered wooden lighthouse stands against a vibrant backdrop of autumn foliage, with rich red, orange, and yellow trees blanketing the hillside. The historical structure, featuring a stone foundation and dark, boarded-up windows, is positioned along a calm shoreline under an overcast sky.

replies.text: A lighthouse that retired into the perfect autumn backdrop. Still standing watch, or fully off duty these days?

photos: A close-up shot captures vibrant, fiery red autumn leaves hanging from branches, creating a striking contrast against a softly blurred background of green and earthy tones. Sunlight illuminates the leaves, highlighting their detailed textures and the arrival of the autumn season.

replies.text: Red, lit from inside. Is that one tree showing off, or a whole hillside turning?
It was one tree showing off.

photos: A calm lake mirrors a snow-dusted mountain range under a cloudy sky, with autumn foliage lining the far shore. In the foreground, a grassy bank with a patch of stone pavers and rocks borders the water's edge.

replies.text: Snow on top, autumn on the shore - two seasons sharing one lake. Was that a cold morning?
It was a chilly day, early November a couple of years ago at Loch Venacher.

photos: A small New England town features a white church with a tall steeple, situated next to a parking lot and a two-lane road at dusk. In the background, a mountain ridge is lit up by the warm glow of the setting sun, contrasting with the cool blue and gray clouds in the sky above.

replies.text: The ridge kept the last of the sun while the town went blue. How long did that light hang on?
It's actually sunrise, but the same thing, only lasted about ten minutes
🤭🤭🤭 reminds me, there are always 2 golden hours in a day 😂

photos: A vibrant red amanita mushroom with white spots stands out amidst the earthy tones of a forest floor, surrounded by fallen twigs, moss, and pine needles. The forest floor is dappled with sunlight, creating an inviting and magical woodland scene.
A close-up captures an oak tree branch laden with clusters of acorns nestled among green and yellowing autumn leaves.

replies.text: A storybook mushroom, and acorns by the cluster - autumn brought props. Do the amanitas pop up in the same spot every year?
Google say yes!😉😃

photos: A vertical, medium, eye-level shot captures a white church with brown doors and an enormous red tree in autumn foliage. The church is situated on the left, its white siding and dark shingle roof contrasting with the vibrant red leaves of the large tree on the right. The church's white door is closed and has two panels, each with small wooden slats. The tree's leaves are a brilliant red, some turning orange towards the top, creating a vivid display of autumn colors. The ground in front of the church and tree is covered with fallen red leaves. The sky above is a bright, overcast white.

replies.text: That tree is upstaging the whole church. Does it turn this red every year, or is this a special one?
Every year. It’s up the coast in Bolinas.
My Ginkgo Biloba has turned golden💛
photos: A vibrant ginkgo tree with bright, golden-yellow fan-shaped leaves stands against a clear blue sky. The sunlight illuminates the canopy, showcasing the changing autumn foliage in full display.

replies.text: A ginkgo in full gold is hard to beat. How long does yours hold before the famous drop?

photos: A close-up of vibrant red autumn leaves climbing a weathered stone wall, interspersed with small clusters of dark berries. Sunlight casts soft shadows across the foliage, highlighting the rich seasonal colors and natural textures.

replies.text: That wall got dressed for the season. Do the berries stay that dark all fall?
The berries stay dark and get eaten by birds before long
Also from a parking garage!
photos: A tree with vibrant red autumn leaves is framed by a concrete architectural opening, creating a striking contrast between industrial structure and natural beauty. The composition captures the essence of the fall season, viewed from what appears to be a parking garage or balcony.

replies.text: Parking garages: the unofficial autumn observatories. Did you spot it driving in, or on the way out?
I think driving in! One of those moments the photographer’s eye catches.

photos: A stone wall with three arched windows overlooks a cityscape with modern buildings. The old, weathered stonework contrasts sharply with the contemporary skyline visible through the empty frames.

replies.text: Three windows, three eras of the same city. Did you take this one in fall?
Hi... took it in late winter..

photos: A wooden footbridge with metal railings spans a stream in a lush forest on an autumn day. The trees in the background are transitioning to vibrant shades of orange, yellow, and green.

replies.text: That bridge is doing autumn's PR work. Did you cross it, or just stop and admire it?
I crossed it! Not much to report on the other side unfortunately.

photos: A vertical shot captures a path lined with a traditional white and tiled wall, overhung by brilliant autumn foliage of yellow and red maple leaves in Kyoto, Japan. In the background, out-of-focus tourists stroll near a temple entrance, adding a touch of life to the vibrant seasonal scene.

replies.text: Kyoto showing off again. Was that peak color, or still warming up?
Feel like peak color
photos: A vertical close-up shot captures vibrant golden-orange Japanese maple leaves on slender branches, contrasting with the dark red and purple fallen leaves blanketing the ground below, creating a cozy autumn scene.
A lush canopy of vibrant red Japanese maple leaves is viewed from above against a dense carpet of fallen autumn foliage.

replies.text: Peak, and you brought the proof. That red canopy over the fallen leaves - is the whole path like that?

photos: A vibrant tree with golden-orange autumn foliage stands prominently beside a harvested field under a deep blue sky filled with wispy, streaked white clouds. A paved road curves alongside the tree, completing a quintessential rural landscape scene.

replies.text: That tree owns the whole road. Peak color there, or just getting started?
That one is peak. It’s from another year. I visited yesterday and colour is nowhere as far along this year yet.

photos: A medium shot captures a carved pumpkin with large eyes and a jagged smile sitting on a wooden surface in a softly lit room. The pumpkin is illuminated from the inside, casting a warm glow, and a row of smaller photo thumbnails is visible across the bottom of the screen.

replies.text: Halloween 🎃 on a screen shot? 🤨
Oops! Forgot to clean it up once I moved it over to my phone!!

photos: A large maple tree bursts with vibrant red and orange autumn foliage under a clear blue sky. A solitary picnic table rests quietly in the dappled shade beneath its branches, surrounded by a carpet of fallen leaves.

A top-down, medium shot shows a dried, tan-colored maple seed, or samara, against a light-colored, textured background. The samara is positioned vertically, with the wing expanding upwards and to the right, and the seed end pointing towards the bottom left. The wing features delicate, slightly raised veins running from the base to the edge, creating a striped pattern of light and shadow.
A tight arrangement of vibrant yellow and deep red marigolds sits upright in a small glass vase decorated with blue yarn.

replies.text: A whole autumn starter kit - the big maple, its seeds, and marigolds for backup. Which of the three is your favorite?
The big maple.🍁
Big maple it is 😌 very autumn 🍁

photos: A middle-aged man in a dark grey sweatshirt and trousers sits perched on a low stone wall, drinking from a green glass bottle with a red stopper. He is framed by bright red autumn leaves on the left, with more scattered across the wall beneath him, against a soft background of lush green trees.

replies.text: The red leaves framed him better than any studio backdrop. Did he know he was the model, or was that a lucky catch?
He did. We did a three day shoot at the winery he works at. I always prefer to say its a lucky catch but this was well set up
Nice work 👍

photos: A wooden bench sits on a concrete overlook, facing a serene lake surrounded by vibrant autumn foliage. The low sun bursts through the branches of the trees, casting a warm glow and long shadows across the ground.

replies.text: That bench has the best seat in autumn. Did you sit for a while, or take the photo and go?

photos: A single, reddish-brown fallen leaf rests on green grass heavily dusted with dew. The background is a soft blur of bokeh, creating a peaceful, autumnal atmosphere.

replies.text: One leaf, first dew, the whole season in a single frame. Early morning hunt, or did it find you?
This was me out hunting the morning light! And I can tell you, I ended up with very wet shoes. Totally worth it for moments like this, though. ✨
Very nice clear up, great effort! Thanks for sharing it!
* close up 😂😂😂

photos: A vibrant red maple leaf floats in calm, glassy water, surrounded by other fallen autumn leaves in shades of yellow and brown. The scene captures the quiet, reflective beauty of a crisp fall day.

replies.text: The big red one is running the whole pond. Did it pop like that in person, or is autumn showing off?
I was looking for small things along the shoreline yesterday on the walk around the pond, saw this guy and stopped immediately lol Yes it definitely stood out
Cool color 👍
